steps.label: 1954-qa-item2089175-empty-omr-notice
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/item/all/detail.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089175'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Expected QA item without a modal');const b=document.querySelector('.omr-preview-btn[data-omr-saved]');if(!b||b.hasAttribute('data-saved-omr')||b.hasAttribute('data-saved-answer'))throw Error('Expected missing saved OMR attributes, re-observe changed data');b.click();return {type:b.dataset.questionType,savedOmr:b.getAttribute('data-saved-omr'),savedAnswer:b.getAttribute('data-saved-answer'),alerts:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert]')].map(e=>e.textContent),modalCount:document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show').length,previewFrameCount:document.querySelectorAll('#omrPreviewModal iframe').length};})()
